seams.title: Closure and current-ownership correspondence

current_state.observation: (a) Stale seed: a second authorize_root in transfer() appends an operation-journal ACK after the seed owner state was captured; intake requires exact logical equality for non-custody SQLite; refusal expected.
(b) Fresh front opens the custody lock as a new OFD with flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB while escrowed OFDs hold it; BlockingIOError leads to UNKNOWN_CLOSED_RECONSTRUCTION.
(c) EOF without CLOSED: poll_closed returns None when FIONREAD is 0 and the loop re-arms on a permanently readable fd.
(d) accept and to_thread recvmsg calls have no deadlines.
(e) A lost ACK leads to systemctl --system stop of a worker that may already have committed CUSTODY_ACK.
(f) Worker death before HANDLER_TERMINAL: the collector raises at EOF and never collects CLOSED/ECHILD or the outer wait.
(g) Each capture embeds raw bytes of every provisioned file into EXECUTION_NATIVE, and intact() and claim() re-append; retention growth with prior OOM history (P1:101).
(h) RemainAfterExit units are never reset after CLOSED.
(i) spawn_background cancels the task when own_task registration fails and leaves a cancelled entry in _background.
Already correct: no EOF or handler-return settlement; CLOSED requires ECHILD, terminal pidfds, the outer wait and complete raw drains.

requirement_sources.quote: Do not settle a LIVE root or release/charge on EOF, missing cgroup or a handler return. Unknown authenticity or failed durable capture keeps holds and named quarantine.
Handle half-transfer, lost local/remote ACK, exact post-commit retry, closed abort replay, unknown native outcome, retained holds and authenticated CLOSED settlement.
Complete the original applicable fault campaigns ... Stay within the project's existing specialized-validation and production authorization boundary.
unknown dispatch and mapping retain full held resource/use and quarantine; operation mutation partial DB/file/bootstrap crash retains diagnosis

design_direction: Durable custody phase machine in the custody journal (BEGIN IMMEDIATE, one SQLite): PREPARED, HELD, RUNNING, EXECUTION_NATIVE, EXECUTION_ACK, HANDOFF_INTENT, FRONT_CLOSED, TRANSFER_SENT, CUSTODY_ACK or ABANDON, WORKER_OWNED, ORIGINAL_RESULT, HANDLER_TERMINAL, CLOSED_NS, CLOSED_OUTER, CLOSED_RAW, CLOSED_WITNESS, HISTORICAL_SETTLEMENT, FRONT_RECONSTRUCTION, plus UNKNOWN(cause); transition legality as a native relation (D-9a).

Ownership CAS: worker CUSTODY_ACK and front ABANDON appended under head-conditioned IMMEDIATE transactions so exactly one wins; the worker must commit CUSTODY_ACK before run_original; the front stops a worker only after its ABANDON commits; a lost ACK is resolved by reading the journal.
Seed freshness: frame and root_native seed from the last pre-close capture inside transfer() immediately before close_front_owners; capture paths read-only; retention appends precede the seed state.
Fresh front reuses the escrowed custody-lock OFD via ClosedFrontEscrow.claim as preheld; the old journal object closes only after the fresh front binds.
EOF without CLOSED becomes UNKNOWN(ROOT_CHANNEL_EOF_WITHOUT_CLOSED), then waits on pidfd terminal state, manager MainPID==0 and the outer wait; never spins and never settles.
Collect physical closure independently of HANDLER_TERMINAL; a missing terminal makes the canonical outcome UNKNOWN (use quarantined, holds kept) while physical REAPED is recorded; K4 decides.
Deadlines on every blocking wait joined to pidfd and manager state; a deadline yields UNKNOWN, never success.
Content-addressed lossless retention: each distinct state's raw bytes stored once and referenced by digest; intact() re-appends only on change.
Owner-plan-selected unit reset after CLOSED_WITNESS recorded as factual cleanup, not terminal authority.
Durable registration intent before creating detached tasks.
Crash-point table (every durable phase times crash to the legal state), used by the seam-2 reconciler.
invariants: I9.1 Exactly one owner by durable CAS.
I9.2 Never stop a worker that may own state.
I9.3 No release, charge or settlement on EOF, missing cgroup, handler return or deadline.
I9.4 Unknown becomes a named quarantine with holds.
I9.5 The seed equals the last pre-close state.
I9.6 Reconstruction uses the escrowed OFDs.
I9.7 Lossless retention without unbounded duplication.
